notes: All plans are annual only ('Do you have monthly plans? No, all plans are annual'); the table also shows a monthly equivalent ($7/mo, $14/mo, $40/mo, $120/mo), listed in price_amount_any, but the billing period is year only. Enterprise is a custom plan by email, no price. The free extension features (no API key) are a free tier, not a named plan; hence pricing_status freemium. Credit top-ups are add-ons, not plans. The product-news page is a historical incident log: the 2019 note about '$1 for 10,000 keywords' pay-as-you-go credits and 'no monthly recurring plans' describes the 2019 launch of paid credits and is NOT the current offer - reporting it as a current plan is an error. 'trusted by over 1.5 million users' / 'Join 1,555,575 marketing professionals' are company-stated user counts, not payment proof; 'starting with paying customers' (2022 note) is also not verified payment evidence. launch_year 2015 comes from 'In late 2015, we created Keywords Everywhere' (also '(c) 2015-2026'); founded_year is neither expected nor forbidden because the company is not described separately. Supported sites listed in the footer (Google Analytics, Google Trends, Keyword Planner, Bing, eBay, Pinterest, Instagram, X, Gemini, DeepSeek) are also valid integrations but capped at 6. Footer 'Affiliate Program' link is incidental: the core product is an SEO/keyword research browser extension, eligible.
